review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take ownership of critical infrastructure while working closely with cybersecurity, cloud, and technology partners. Qualifications 8+ years of systems or infrastructure engineering experience. At least 3 years of experience owning production server environments, patch management, and privileged infrastructure changes . For an engineer who enjoys being hands-on but wants broader ownership and exposure to security, this role provides a strong combination of technical depth, autonomy, and long-term growth potential.
